provenance.label: SYNTHETIC / DEMO-ONLY
provenance.description: Hand-authored aggregate events for an invented HoloMart preview cohort. No real telemetry, shoppers, sellers, searches, listings, or prices are included.
limitations: Small fictional cohort and short observation window
No control group, statistical inference, or causal attribution
Event counts may contain repeat actions by the same synthetic shopper
Search names, query text, filter values, card identities, and prices are intentionally excluded

signals.name: saved_search_created
signals.interpretation: Some active shoppers tried creation, but most eligible shoppers did not.
signals.tension: Low adoption could mean low value, weak discoverability, or a narrow repeat-collector audience.

signals.name: saved_search_opened
signals.interpretation: Most creators reopened at least one search during the window.
signals.tension: The aggregate does not distinguish genuine shopping from repeated prototype testing.

signals.name: saved_search_opened_later_session
signals.interpretation: Twenty-one creators show directional later-session reuse.
signals.tension: Browser-local storage cannot reveal whether cross-device continuity matters.

signals.name: filters_changed_after_search_open
signals.interpretation: Saved criteria may serve as a starting point rather than a fixed destination.
signals.tension: Edits might instead indicate stale or overly broad saved state.

signals.name: saved_search_deleted
signals.interpretation: Deletion is used and should remain understandable and recoverable.
signals.tension: The synthetic event model does not capture why a search was deleted.

signals.name: saved_search_storage_parse_error
signals.interpretation: Local state can fail and requires a safe recovery path.
signals.tension: The sample is too small to estimate a failure rate.

signals.name: mobile_saved_search_opened
signals.interpretation: Opening a saved search on a narrow viewport is plausible.
signals.tension: There are no synthetic mobile creation events; coverage may be incomplete.

proposedMetricDefinitions.name: laterSessionReuseRate
proposedMetricDefinitions.definition: Unique creators who open a search in a later session divided by unique creators.

proposedMetricDefinitions.name: creatorPenetration
proposedMetricDefinitions.definition: Unique creators divided by active catalog shoppers.
